job.question: According to the ILPA Due Diligence Questionnaire v1.2, when was version 1.1 released and what changes did it introduce?
job.expected_facts: Version 1.1 was released in September 2016. It (1) added new questions on compliance with the ILPA Reporting Template (released January 2016) to the Accounting / Valuation / Reporting sections; (2) revised the original Governance and Risk / Compliance / ESG sections to reflect PRI's new LP Responsible Investment DDQ, and re-ordered, merged and edited existing questions in those sections; and (3) refreshed existing web links, font and formatting as needed.
job.acceptance: September 2016 plus the three substantive revision groups; concise paraphrases accepted.

reviews.reason: The supplied document is ILPA DDQ 2.0, not v1.2. It mentions v1.2 only as the previous version and gives neither the September 2016 release date for v1.1 nor its three revision groups.
